description: TXN-SUPPORT, the unexplained ADO Rollback refusal (0x800A0BB9 on every Rollback in the first card, with each Execute's recordset left open). Two ADODB.Connections in turn on the writable main copy, each with the worker's event sink on ConnectionEvents: cnA runs BeginTrans three times, an UPDATE whose returned recordset is bound and closed, and three Rollbacks; cnB runs BeginTrans twice, an UPDATE with adExecuteNoRecords (options 129) and RecordsAffected by reference, and CommitTrans then Rollback; then cnB runs BeginTrans, UPDATE with the recordset left open, Rollback. Rollback errors are read right after each. A DAO open reads the rows. Asks whether the open recordset is what makes ADO Rollback fail, which events ADO raises per call, and the by-reference RecordsAffected.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
